questions.stem: A 45 years old female with family history of hearing loss from her mother’s side developed hearing problem during pregnancy. Impaired hearing is bilateral, slowly progressive, with bilateral tinnitus. Pure tone audiometry shows apparent bone conduction hearing loss at 2000 Hz. What is the most likely diagnosis?
